title: VeriChip implant, Raytheon lineage, and retaliation suggestion

tellings.quote: The chip was introduced to the market in 2002, just a few years before Gary's experience in 2005.

plain: An implantable tracking chip called the VeriChip went on sale in 2002, Michels says, "just a few years before Gary's experience in 2005", meaning Gary McKinnon, a computer hacker who says he found signs of a secret NASA space programme. Working from the company's prospectus filings, Michels traces the chip to a firm called Applied Digital Solutions and links it back to the defence company Raytheon. He suggests the chip may tie into retaliation against McKinnon, which would mean a hacker was punished with a corporate surveillance technology.
